profile.name: langchain-mcp-adapters

intro.title: LangChain MCP Adapters
intro.desc: This library provides a lightweight wrapper that makes Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools compatible with LangChain and LangGraph.

features: 📦 A client implementation that allows you to connect to multiple MCP servers and load tools from them
